title: Chicken Marbella

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: head, peeled and pureed to make about 1/4 cup

ingredients.name: capers with a bit of juice

steps.text: Wash and dry chicken, trimming excess fat if time permits. Peel and puree garlic to make about 1/4 cup.
Combine chicken, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, vinegar, olive oil, prunes, olives, capers and their juice, and bay leaves in a large bowl. Cover and marinate overnight.
Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Arrange chicken in a single layer in two shallow baking pans, skin-side up, and spoon marinade evenly over it. Sprinkle with brown sugar and pour wine around the chicken.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, basting frequently with pan juices, until juices from the thigh pieces run clear rather than pink.
Transfer chicken, prunes, olives and capers to a platter with a slotted spoon. Moisten with pan juices, sprinkle generously with parsley or cilantro, and pass remaining juices separately.

notes: Chicken keeps and improves over several refrigerated days. To cook ahead, bake 35 minutes, then finish while reheating. To serve at room temperature, cool in the cooking juices before transferring; after refrigeration, return to room temperature and spoon reserved juice over it. Serving ideas: rice or couscous, braised carrots, cauliflower, or salad with fruit. Source note: Great party dish, but not for buffet because a knife is needed.
